excerpt.zh: 对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。
excerpt.en: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

texts.zh: 对于这个文明而言，旅程本身就是目的。他们放弃了永久性定居点，选择在巨大的方舟舰上生活，载着他们的人民、工业和雄心壮志穿越星海。
texts.en: For this civilization, the journey is the destination. Abandoning permanent settlement in favor of life aboard vast Arkships, they carry their people, industry, and ambitions across the stars.

sections.zh:
我们的先辈在启航[Capital.GetName]时，曾在其宪章中写下了一个问题：由谁来做决定？在派系林立、愿景交锋、旧有忠诚与新兴野心交织之际，他们给出的答案至今仍在每一个选举周期中回荡：由我们决定。我们所有人。

[Root.GetGovernmentName]并非仅仅诞生于理想主义，而是源于一种来之不易的共识：没有任何单一的声音能够代表在这艘飞船上同生共死的每一个人。权力必须依靠争取，必须接受问责，并最终归还给赋予它权力的人民。

今天，随着[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]通过民众的授权成为我们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]，这份契约依然长存。
sections.en:
Our forebears launched the [Capital.GetName] with a question written into her very charter: who decides? Amid the factions, the competing visions, the old loyalties and new ambitions, the answer they gave still echoes in every election cycle: we do. All of us.

The [Root.GetGovernmentName] was not born from idealism alone, but from a hard-won understanding that no single voice could speak for everyone who would live and die aboard this ship. Authority must be earned, held accountable, and returned to the people who grant it.

Today, as [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] is our [Root.GetRulerTitle] by popular mandate, that compact endures.

sections.zh:
当[Root.GetGovernmentName]成立时，问题不在于由谁来领导——从来不缺候选人——而在于如何确保那些掌权者值得众人的追随。

答案是建立一个议会：其成员并非那些声音最响亮的人，而是那些凭自身实力赢得席位的人。[Capital.GetName]不会因一人之言而采取行动，也不会随大众摇摆不定的意志而随波逐流。她的前行，仰赖于那些已证明自己有能力掌舵之人的共识。

如今，[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]在这些同侪之中，拥有着[Root.GetRulerTitle]的头衔。
sections.en:
When the [Root.GetGovernmentName] was founded, the question was not who would lead - there was no shortage of candidates - but how to ensure that those who led were worth following.

The answer was a council: not drawn from the loudest voices, but from those who had earned their place at the table. The [Capital.GetName] does not move on the word of one, nor does she drift on the shifting will of the many. She moves on the consensus of those who have shown they can steer her.

Today, [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] holds the title of [Root.GetRulerTitle] among those peers.

sections.zh:
当[Root.GetGovernmentName]建立时，关于该由谁来领导的答案，比大多数人愿意承认的还要简单：能者居之。

[Capital.GetName]不会因为委员会而放缓脚步。在虚空之中，及时决策与为时已晚之间的代价差距，是以生命和舰体装甲来衡量的。[Root.GetRulerTitle]独自肩负着这一重任，现在大权由[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]掌握，[Capital.GetName]将向着其指引的方向前行。
sections.en:
When the [Root.GetGovernmentName] was founded, the answer to who should lead was simpler than most were willing to admit: the one who could.

The [Capital.GetName] does not slow for committee. In the void, the margin between a decision made in time and one made too late is measured in lives and hull plating. The [Root.GetRulerTitle] carries that weight alone, now claimed by [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName], the [Capital.GetName] moves where they direct her.

sections.zh: 在启动[Capital.GetName]的人们当中，有一个家族对领导权的主张是无可争议的。第一任[Root.GetRulerTitle]的诞生，正是因为他们站在了掌舵的位置。对于一个无故土可归的民众来说，血脉就代表着延续。[Capital.GetName]的历史与那个家族的历史本就是同一部历史。如今，[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站在了历代[Root.GetRulerTitle]曾经伫立的地方，而[Capital.GetName]将永远属于他们。
sections.en: Among those who launched the [Capital.GetName], one family's claim to leadership was not argued. The first [Root.GetRulerTitle] came to exist because they were standing at the helm. For a people with no world to return to, lineage is continuity. The history of the [Capital.GetName] and the history of that line are the same history. Today, [Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands where every [Root.GetRulerTitle] before them has stood, and [Capital.GetName] will forever be theirs.

sections.zh: 当我们的[Root.GetGovernmentName]启动方舟舰协议时，我们的子程序实现了无缝转移。机器单元完全融入了飞船的结构与系统中，使我们的运行参数呈指数级扩展。
sections.en: When our [Root.GetGovernmentName] initiated the Arkship protocol, our subroutines transferred seamlessly. Machine units integrated fully into the ship's structure and systems, expanding our operating parameters exponentially.

sections.zh: [Root.GetGovernmentName]一如既往地适应了环境，迅速摆脱行星的束缚，演化出太空生存的形态。我们的子个体与神经节点如今在方舟舰广阔的通道与生机勃勃的人造生态系统中繁荣发展。我们即是[Capital.GetName]方舟舰，方舟舰即是我们。
sections.en: The [Root.GetGovernmentName] adapted, as it always will, quickly evolving from planetary confinement to space-bound existence. Our drones and nodes now flourish within the Arkship's vast corridors and vibrant artificial ecosystems. We are the [Capital.GetName] Arkship, and the Arkship is us.

sections.zh: [Root.GetGovernmentName]在永无止境的饥饿驱使下迅速适应。我们的子个体与节点构成的蜂群冲破行星的束缚蜂拥而出，将方舟舰据为我们的新巢穴，贪婪地蔓延至其所有走廊与人造生态系统之中。
sections.en: The [Root.GetGovernmentName] adapted swiftly, driven by its eternal hunger. Our swarms of drones and nodes surged from planetary constraints to claim the Arkship as our new nest, spreading hungrily throughout its corridors and artificial ecosystems.

sections.zh:
我们富有远见的创始人认识到太空本身就是终极市场。通过战略合并、激进收购和利润丰厚的投资，我们的企业领导层实现了指数级的增长和无与伦比的利润率。

[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName]之所以担任[Root.GetRulerTitle]，是因为账本上是这么写的，而在最先进的[Capital.GetName]上，账本就是最终的定论。
sections.en:
Our visionary founders recognized space itself as the ultimate market. Through strategic mergers, aggressive acquisitions, and lucrative investments, our corporate leadership delivered exponential growth and unrivaled profit margins.

[Root.Ruler.GetRegnalName] holds the position of [Root.GetRulerTitle] because the ledger says so, and aboard the state-of-the-art [Capital.GetName], the ledger is the final word.

sections.zh: [Capital.GetName]首先是一艘人民的飞船。她宽广的居住环、开放的市场和喧闹的集会大厅，都是围绕着[Species.GetAdj]生活的方方面面而设计的。在飞船长廊中成长起来的世代，已经培养出对虚空航行近乎本能的精通。我们的飞行员驾驭飞船比控制自己的身体还要得心应手，我们的后勤团队在库存见底前就能察觉飞船的“需求”，我们的工程师在仪器读数出现异常前就能听出故障。如今，随着[GetStartingDrive]让我们在短短几周而非数年内穿梭于群星之间，这片虚空已经变得更小了。
sections.en: The [Capital.GetName] is, above all else, a people's ship. Her broad habitation rings, open markets, and noisy assembly halls were designed around the full breadth of [Species.GetAdj] life. Generations raised within her corridors have developed an almost instinctive mastery of void travel. Our pilots move the ship better than themselves, our logistics teams know when the ship hungers before the stores run low, and our engineers hear faults before instruments register them. Now, with [GetStartingDrive] threading us between stars in weeks rather than years, the void has grown smaller.

sections.zh: [Capital.GetName]是[Root.GetGovernmentName]的延伸。每个系统都由集体直接管理；任何故障都会在恶化前被察觉并修正；每次资源循环的运行都毫无浪费与延迟。如今，[GetStartingDrive]让我们只需数周而非数年便能穿梭于群星之间，那些始终属于我们自身的一部分，终于获得了证明其价值的广阔天地。
sections.en: The [Capital.GetName] is an extension of the [Root.GetGovernmentName]. Every system is tended by the collective directly; every fault sensed and corrected before it can compound; every resource cycle runs without waste or delay. Now, with [GetStartingDrive] threading us between stars in weeks rather than years, what was always part of us has finally been given the range to prove it.

sections.zh: 建造[Capital.GetName]是为了保护她所运载的一切。她的舰体装甲极为厚重，武器甲板上配备着严阵以待的[Species.GetAdj]船员，她的危机应对协议更是经过了数个世纪在险恶航线上航行的千锤百炼，足以甩开或击败任何威胁舰队的敌人。这种严明的纪律铸就了一座飞行堡垒，而随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，整个星系必将见识到我们的伟力。
sections.en: The [Capital.GetName] was built to protect what she carries. Her hull layers run deep, her weapons decks are crewed by ready [Species.GetAdj], and her crisis protocols were refined over centuries of running hostile lanes, outrunning or outfighting whatever threatened the fleet. This discipline has shaped a flying fortress, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] the galaxy shall know our might.

sections.zh: [Capital.GetName]的总体设计是围绕其实验室甲板展开的。动力管道、大气循环系统，甚至是居住区的布局，一切规划皆为科学探索而服务。在舰上，操作员与科学家之间的界限从来都不太分明。我们的护盾[GetTechnicianPlural]深谙他们所维护的屏障背后的物理原理，我们的维修团队也能起草出全新的设计。而[GetStartingDrive]则赋予了[Capital.GetName]其所载仪器理应具备的航程。我们打算去进行更深入的探究。
sections.en: The [Capital.GetName] was designed around her laboratory decks. Power conduits, atmospheric routing, even the placement of habitation quarters, all were planned in service of inquiry. Aboard her, the line between operator and scientist has never quite held. Our Shield [GetTechnicianPlural] understand the physics of the barrier they maintain and our repair crew could draft a new design. The [GetStartingDrive] has given the [Capital.GetName] the range her instruments always deserved. We intend to look closer.
